name: Backlog & Release Planning (SDLC Phase 6)
description: Planning feature development and releases — aka Roadmapping, Program Increment Planning, Flight Plan, Delivery Strategy.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Backlog & Release Planning
capabilities.description: Translates the product roadmap into a sequenced, dependency-aware backlog and release plan ready for execution.

services.name: Outcome-Based Product Roadmap
services.contractDescription: Strategic product roadmap mapping Now/Next/Later horizons to measurable business outcomes.

services.name: Feature/Epic Backlog & Acceptance Criteria
services.contractDescription: Sequenced user story backlog with explicit Given/When/Then acceptance criteria and story point estimates.

services.name: Release Plan
services.contractDescription: Release milestones, deployment train schedule, scope boundaries, and target release dates.

services.name: Feature Flag & Rollout Strategy
services.contractDescription: Canary deployment, targeted user cohort segmentation, and feature kill-switch rules.

services.name: Dependency Map
services.contractDescription: Cross-team, inter-service, and external API dependency graph mapping critical path bottlenecks.

services.name: Governance & RACI Chart
services.contractDescription: Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed matrix for release decision-making.

checklists.name: Backlog & Release Planning (SDLC Phase 6) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for backlog refinement, release sequencing, and dependency mapping.

items.statement: Every backlog item in the feature/epic backlog carries clear, testable acceptance criteria.
Critical path dependencies between backend services and frontend components are mapped with clear ownership.
Release plan defines target dates, freeze windows, and rollback criteria.
Feature flag rollout strategy details target user cohorts and telemetry kill-switch triggers.
RACI matrix assigns explicit single-point accountability for release sign-off.

reviewGates.name: Release Planning Review
reviewGates.statement: The Release Plan and refined backlog have been reviewed and accepted as ready for execution.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the Release Plan realistic, dependency-checked, and backed by a refined backlog with testable acceptance criteria?
